svg.title: Gas Heaven (tiles v003) — collision layout
svg.desc: North is up. Coordinates in meters. Dark shapes block sight and movement; gray shapes block movement only. Windows and pallets occupy gaps. Grid spacing is eight meters.
svg.text: Gas Heaven (tiles v003) · 88 × 120 m · 1 tile = 8 m
9536 m² · 17 pallets · 16 windows · 12 generator candidates · 19 hooks · max hook walk 26 m
